summary.result: The pumping patterns from the stations were analyzed and the results were applied to ungauged pumping stations in the basin.
summary.background: The objective of this paper are to present a realistic methodology to estimate the daily water supply rates form irrigation pumping stattions, to validate it with the field data, and to report the daily irrigation pumping rates from the Han river basin.
summary.method: The method was appliedto five stations which were field monitored during the irragation periods in 1998.
